description: Abstract class defining the processing of registration events within the OrangeHRM system, including event saving, data gathering, and publishing mechanisms.

classes.name: AbstractRegistrationEventProcessor
classes.description: Defines the structure and core functionalities for processing registration events, including saving, data collection, and publishing.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventQueueDao
methods.description: Returns the DAO object for registration event queue operations.

methods.name: getRegistrationAPIClientService
methods.description: Returns the service object for registration API client interactions.

methods.name: getOrganizationService
methods.description: Returns the service object for organization-related data.

methods.name: saveRegistrationEvent
methods.description: Saves a registration event if conditions are met.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventGeneralData
methods.description: Gathers and returns general registration data, including admin info and system details.

methods.name: processRegistrationEventToSave
methods.description: Creates a RegistrationEventQueue object with event data and timestamp.

methods.name: publishRegistrationEvents
methods.description: Publishes pending registration events to an external API if in production mode.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventPublishDataPrepared
methods.description: Prepares event data for publishing by adding type and event time.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Abstract method to get the event type identifier.

methods.name: getEventData
methods.description: Abstract method to get the event data array.

methods.name: getEventToBeSavedOrNot
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if the event should be saved.
